name: scale_x_vx
hypothesis: Increase sensitivity to lateral position (x) and horizontal velocity (vx) by scaling those inputs, encouraging earlier side‑thruster usage to counter crosswind.

name: scale_x_vx_angle
hypothesis: Double sensitivity to lateral position, horizontal velocity, body angle, and angular velocity to improve early side‑thruster and attitude corrections under crosswind, aiming to raise safe landing and goal success rates while preserving solution rate.

name: side_thruster_offset
hypothesis: Add a positive bias to side thruster logits to encourage side thruster usage under crosswind, improving lateral control and safe landing.

name: combined_input_output
hypothesis: Increase sensitivity to lateral position and horizontal velocity (scale 2x) and moderately boost angle and angular velocity (1.5x) to improve early side‑thruster and attitude corrections; also amplify side‑thruster logits (scale 1.5, offset +0.2) and slightly reduce main‑engine influence (scale 0.9) to prioritize lateral control under strong crosswind.

name: strong_x_vx_sidebias
hypothesis: Scale lateral position and horizontal velocity by 2.5 to increase sensitivity to crosswind drift, and boost side‑thruster logits (scale 1.2, offset +0.2) to encourage earlier side‑thruster usage while keeping main engine unchanged.

name: moderate_input_sidebias
hypothesis: Moderately increase sensitivity to lateral position and horizontal velocity (1.5×) and slightly boost angle and angular velocity (1.2×) to improve crosswind handling; bias side thrusters (+0.2) and amplify them (1.2×) while slightly reducing main engine influence (0.9×) to prioritize lateral control.

name: enhanced_input_output_hidden
hypothesis: Moderately increase sensitivity to lateral position, horizontal velocity, body angle, and angular velocity (1.5× for x and vx, 1.5× for angle and angular velocity) to improve crosswind handling; bias side thruster logits (+0.3) and amplify them (1.5×) while slightly reducing main engine influence (0.85×) to prioritize lateral control; also boost the second hidden layer activations (1.2×) to make the network's decisions more decisive.

name: balanced_input_output_hidden
hypothesis: Increase sensitivity to lateral position and horizontal velocity (2×) and to body angle and angular velocity (1.5×) so the policy detects cross‑wind drift and attitude errors earlier; boost side‑thruster logits (scale 1.4, offset +0.25) to encourage earlier side‑thruster usage while slightly reducing main‑engine influence (scale 0.85) to avoid excessive vertical thrust; amplify the second hidden layer (scale 1.2) to make the network's decisions more decisive under the noisy cross‑wind conditions.

name: aggressive_sidebias
hypothesis: Increase side‑thruster scaling to 1.3 and add a +0.3 bias while reducing main‑engine scaling to 0.8; keep moderate input scaling (1.5× for lateral position and horizontal velocity, 1.2× for body angle and angular velocity) to encourage earlier side‑thruster corrections under crosswind without over‑reacting.

name: enhanced_sidebias
hypothesis: Increase side‑thruster scaling to 1.4 and add a +0.3 bias while reducing main‑engine scaling to 0.85; keep moderate input scaling (1.5× for lateral position and horizontal velocity, 1.3× for body angle and angular velocity) to encourage earlier side‑thruster corrections under crosswind without over‑reacting.

name: moderate_input_hidden
hypothesis: Add hidden scaling to the second hidden layer (1.2×) while keeping the moderate input scaling (1.5× for lateral position and horizontal velocity, 1.2× for body angle and angular velocity) and side‑thruster bias (scale 1.2, offset +0.2). This should make the network's decisions more decisive without over‑reacting, improving cross‑wind handling and landing stability.

name: final_aggressive_hidden
hypothesis: Increase sensitivity to lateral position and horizontal velocity (1.8×) and to body angle and angular velocity (1.3×), boost side‑thruster logits (scale 1.4, offset +0.25) while reducing main‑engine influence (scale 0.85). Also amplify both hidden layers (1.2×) to make the network's decisions more decisive under crosswind.
